name: Well of wonders
review:
A wishing well with occurrence wins, respins, multipliers, wilds and a fairy. Wins depend on how many matching symbols appear rather than paylines.

The fairy can add wilds and multipliers when she shows up, and the respins keep things going. Low volatility, 2,280x cap, 96.1% RTP. Relaxed and pretty, and the occurrence wins make it a bit different from the usual.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
